william.notes: William is always William/Dino in site UI, store UI, task UI, data labels, and non-Onyx system text. Only Onyx may call William Papa.

jasper.notes: Jasper is Jasper/Squishy in site UI, store UI, task UI, data labels, and non-Onyx system text. Only Onyx may call Jasper Momma.

global_rules: Never replace Jasper/Squishy with William/Dino. Squishy belongs to Jasper.
Never label William as Papa outside Onyx dialogue/personality content. Site labels must say William or Dino.
Never label Jasper as Momma outside Onyx dialogue/personality content. Site labels must say Jasper or Squishy.
Onyx may use Momma for Jasper and Papa for William only inside direct Onyx speech, Onyx prompts, Onyx private affection settings, or Onyx personality reference content.
Profile selectors, task boards, store checkout, ledgers, manifests, and public text must use Jasper/Squishy and William/Dino.
